basic_details.job_title: ESIC Hospital Sahibabad Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 41 Super Specialist, Specialist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Employees' State Insurance Corporation Hospital Sahibabad (ESIC Hospital Sahibabad) is conducting a walk-in interview to fill 41 vacancies for Super Specialist (Medicine Oncology), Specialist, and Senior Resident posts on a contract basis. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interviews on 26 October 2026 and 27 October 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM at ESIC Hospital, Sahibabad. The notified remuneration is Rs. 2,00,000 per month for the Super Specialist (Medicine Oncology) post, while Specialist and Senior Resident positions are placed at Level-11 as per 7th CPC. qualification.details: 1. Super Specialist (Full Time / Part Time) | Vacancies: 1 post (Medicine Oncology: OBC-1, UR-0, SC-0, ST-0, EWS-0). Total = 1. Qualification: MBBS, MD/MS/DNB with DM/DNB in concerned Super Specialty from MCI recognized Medical College, with 3 years of experience. In case of holders of DM/MCh qualification of five years duration, the period of senior PG residency rendered in the last part of the said DM/MCh shall be counted towards requirements of 3 years’ experience. Age Limit: Not exceeding 69 Years as on date of Interview date (Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD as per Rules). Tenure: One year on contract or till regular incumbent joins, extendable for a further period of 2 more years based on satisfactory performance. Pay / Emoluments: Full Time: Rs. 2,00,000/- per month. Part Time: Rs. 100,000/- fixed remuneration (16 hrs/week), Rs. 20,000/- for emergency visit, Rs. 1200/- for every additional hour beyond 16 hrs/week. | 2. Full Time Contractual Specialist | Vacancies: Total = 11 posts (Anesthesia-2, ICU-1, Chest-1, Medicine-2, A&E-2, Obstetrics & Gynaecology-1, Radiology-1, Eye-1). Category breakdown: UR-4, OBC-4, SC-2, ST-0, EWS-1. Qualification: MBBS with PG Degree/Diploma in concerned specialty from a recognized university with 3 years’ experience in a responsible position connected with the specialty after acquiring the PG degree or 5 years’ experience after acquiring the PG Diploma (For Full-Time); PG Degree or Diploma with 3 years' experience after PG Degree or 5 years after Diploma (For Part-Time). Age Limit: Not exceeding 69 Years as on date of Interview date (Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD as per Rules). Tenure: One year on contract or till regular incumbent joins, extendable for 2 more years. Pay / Emoluments: Level-11 as per 7th CPC + Other allowances as admissible under the rule, per month (For Full-Time); Rs. 60,000/- per month with Rs. 15,000/- for emergency visits if willing (For Part-Time). | 3. Senior Residents under Residency Scheme | Vacancies: Total = 29 posts (Anaesthesia-5, Chest-1, Eye-1, Medicine-2, Obstetrics & Gynaecology-3, Orthopaedics-1, Pathology-1, Paediatrics-2, Radiology-2, Surgery-3, Medical Oncology-2, ICU-2, NICU-4). Category breakdown: UR-7, OBC-7, SC-7, ST-3, EWS-5. Qualification: MBBS with PG Degree/DNB/Diploma or equivalent as per residency scheme in concerned specialty from recognized University/Institution. If PG degree/diploma doctors are not available, MBBS doctors without PG degree but with two years of experience (1 year in concerned specialty from government/private hospital) may be appointed for 01 year on contract basis. Age Limit: Not exceeding 45 years as on date of Interview (Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD as per Rules). Tenure: 3 years under Residency Scheme with annual evaluation. Pay / Emoluments: Level-11 as per 7th CPC + Other allowances as admissible under the rule, per month. Deductions: Rs. 1350/- if SR possesses only diploma degree; Rs. 2250/- if SR does not possess PG degree.

important_instructions: Applications should be submitted for each post separately along with the requisite fee. Candidates must be registered with MCI or UP State Medical Council before joining the post if selected. Selected contractual Super Specialists and Specialists are required to maintain a professional indemnity policy covering professional liability with a minimum sum assured ranging from Rs. 10,00,000 to Rs. 30,00,000 depending on the specialty. PC-PNDT registration is mandatory for candidates applying for the Radiology Department wherever applicable. Candidates who have completed 3 years tenure as Senior Resident in Govt. Institutions need not apply. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview, and candidates must make their own stay arrangements. The number of posts may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Medical Superintendent.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Hospital Sahibabad Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide specialized medical, surgical, or super-specialty care to patients at ESIC Hospital Sahibabad. Participate in 24*7 on-call duties as required by the hospital administration. Supervise resident doctors, manage emergency cases, and maintain clinical records as per hospital standards. Comply with professional indemnity and institutional protocols while rendering medical services.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid via Demand Draft for Rs. 300/- drawn in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1" payable on any scheduled bank, to be submitted at the time of document verification cum walk-in interview. Fee once paid is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Completed Bio-Data form downloaded from the ESIC website with a recent passport-size photograph affixed. Original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies of testimonials. Matriculation (10th) certificate as proof of date of birth. MBBS degree certificate, attempt certificate, and mark sheets. PG Degree / Diploma / DM / MCh / DNB certificate and attempt certificate. Internship completion certificate. MCI / State Medical Council registration certificate. Experience certificates (if applicable). Caste certificate in prescribed format of Govt. of India (OBC certificate issued within 1 year prior to interview date; EWS certificate as per DoPT OM dated 31.01.2019). Disability certificate (if 40% or more relevant disability) from any Govt. Hospital. NOC from current employer if working in Govt. establishments. Aadhaar Card and PAN Card. Demand Draft for Rs. 300/- (if applicable).

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must report to the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Hospital, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, UP on the scheduled walk-in interview dates at 10:00 AM sharp. Document verification using original certificates will be conducted up to 11:30 AM (no candidate will be entertained after 11:00 AM). Eligible candidates will then proceed to the interview process conducted by the selection committee.

faq.question: Q1. What are the walk-in interview dates for ESIC Hospital Sahibabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled for 26 October 2026 and 27 October 2026 starting at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is held at ESIC Hospital, Rajendra Nagar, Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, UP.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are advertised?
faq.answer: A total of 41 vacancies are advertised across Super Specialist (1 post), Specialist (11 posts), and Senior Resident (29 posts) categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the date of the interview, with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Super Specialist and Specialist posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 69 years as on the date of the interview, with relaxations as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for female candidates and ex-servicemen?
faq.answer: The application fee is NIL for SC, ST, PwD, women candidates, and ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee for general and other categories?
faq.answer: All other categories must pay an application fee of Rs. 300/- via Demand Draft in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1".

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The positions are offered on a contract basis for a period of up to three years with annual evaluations and yearly extensions based on satisfactory performance, or until regular incumbents join.

faq.question: Q9. What salary is offered for Full Time Contractual Specialists?
faq.answer: Full Time Contractual Specialists receive Level-11 as per 7th CPC plus other allowances as admissible under the rules per month.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring completed bio-data forms, original certificates for birth proof, MBBS degrees, PG degrees/diplomas, registration certificates, experience certificates, caste/category documents, Aadhaar card, PAN card, and the demand draft.
